# Financial Calculators Tool Reference Guide

## Overview

The `calc_*` tools (implementation `sajha/tools/impl/calc_tools.py`) are pure-math financial calculators. They need no API key and run locally; the only exception is `calc_currency_converter`, which fetches live rates from the free `open.er-api.com` endpoint.

Rates, returns and volatilities are passed **in percent** (e.g. `5.0` for 5%), and percentage outputs are returned in percent.

## Tools

<!-- generated:tools folder=calc -->
<!-- Generated by `python -m sajha.tools guides` from the tool configs in `config/tools/calc/`; edit the configs, not this table. -->

| Tool | Description | Required | Optional (schema default) | Annotations |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `calc_beta` | Beta of a stock against the market: covariance of the two return series divided by the market's variance; the longer series is cut to the length of the shorter. | `stock_returns`, `market_returns` | — | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_black_scholes` | Black-Scholes prices of a European call and put on a non-dividend-paying stock. | `stock_price`, `strike`, `time_years`, `risk_free_rate`, `volatility` | — | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_bond_price` | Price of a fixed-coupon bond with semi-annual coupons, discounted at a flat yield: sum of coupon/(1+y/2)^i plus face/(1+y/2)^(2n). | `coupon_rate`, `yield_rate`, `years` | `face_value` (`1000`) | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_capm` | Expected return under the Capital Asset Pricing Model: rf + beta * (market return - rf). | `risk_free_rate`, `beta`, `market_return` | — | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_compound_interest` | Future value of a lump sum with periodic compounding: FV = P(1 + r/n)^(n*t). | `principal`, `rate`, `years` | `compounds_per_year` (`12`) | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_correlation` | Pearson correlation of two numeric series (population formulas); the longer series is cut to the length of the shorter. | `series_x`, `series_y` | — | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_currency_converter` | Converts an amount between currencies at the latest rate from the open ExchangeRate-API endpoint (open.er-api.com); needs network access, no API key. | — | `from` (`USD`), `to` (`EUR`), `amount` (`1`) | read-only, idempotent, open-world |
| `calc_dcf_model` | Enterprise value by discounted cash flow: grows free cash flow at a constant rate for the projection years, discounts at WACC, and adds a Gordon-growth terminal value. | `free_cash_flow`, `growth_rate`, `wacc` | `terminal_growth` (`2`), `projection_years` (`5`) | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_future_value` | Future value of a single present amount with annual compounding: FV = PV(1 + r)^t. | `present_value`, `rate`, `years` | — | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_irr` | Internal rate of return of a cash flow series (the rate where NPV is zero), found by bisection between -50% and 500% per period. | `cash_flows` | — | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_loan_amortization` | Fixed-payment loan schedule: monthly payment from the annual rate (rate/12 per month), total paid, total interest and a per-year split of principal and interest. | `principal`, `annual_rate`, `months` | — | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_max_drawdown` | Maximum drawdown of a value series: the largest fall from a running peak to a later value. | `portfolio_values` | — | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_npv` | Net present value of a cash flow series: NPV = sum of CF_i / (1 + r)^i, where the first flow is at time 0 (not discounted) and each later flow one period further. | `discount_rate`, `cash_flows` | — | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_percentage_change` | Percentage change from an old value to a new value: (new - old) / \|old\| * 100. | `old_value`, `new_value` | — | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_present_value` | Present value of a single future amount with annual compounding: PV = FV / (1 + r)^t. | `future_value`, `rate`, `years` | — | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_retirement` | Retirement savings projection: compounds the balance annually and adds the contribution at the end of each year. | `current_savings`, `annual_contribution`, `return_rate`, `years` | — | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_sharpe_ratio` | Sharpe ratio: (portfolio return - risk-free rate) / volatility. | `portfolio_return`, `risk_free_rate`, `volatility` | — | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_sortino_ratio` | Sortino ratio: (portfolio return - risk-free rate) / downside deviation. | `portfolio_return`, `risk_free_rate`, `downside_deviation` | — | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |
| `calc_wacc` | Weighted average cost of capital: E/V * cost of equity + D/V * cost of debt * (1 - tax rate). | `equity_value`, `debt_value`, `cost_of_equity`, `cost_of_debt`, `tax_rate` | — | read-only, idempotent, closed-world |

## Usage Examples

Over MCP, send `tools/call` to `POST /mcp`:

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "calc_black_scholes",
    "arguments": {"stock_price": 150, "strike": 155, "time_years": 0.5,
                  "risk_free_rate": 5.0, "volatility": 25.0}
  }
}
```

Over REST, `POST /api/tools/execute` with `{"tool": "<name>", "arguments": {...}}`; the response is `{"success": true, "result": {...}}`. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or `X-API-Key: <key>`. See the [MCP Protocol Guide](../../protocol/MCP%20Protocol%20Guide.md) for protocol details.

More argument examples:

```json
{"tool": "calc_loan_amortization", "arguments": {"principal": 300000, "annual_rate": 6.5, "months": 360}}

{"tool": "calc_dcf_model", "arguments": {"free_cash_flow": 100, "growth_rate": 5.0, "wacc": 9.0,
                                          "terminal_growth": 2.5, "projection_years": 5}}

{"tool": "calc_npv", "arguments": {"discount_rate": 8.0, "cash_flows": [-1000, 300, 400, 500]}}

{"tool": "calc_currency_converter", "arguments": {"from": "USD", "to": "JPY", "amount": 250}}
```
